note: Production aggregates from a travel catalogue, 2026-11-10 to 2026-11-15. Every label was written by Claude agent sessions (Claude Opus 5.5, general-purpose sessions viewing each photo and following the production label guide; for the offer field some also saw the listing's name, category and a short description). No person labelled these photos, so every precision and recall here is agreement with agent labels. Per-photo records are in records.jsonl under opaque ids (first 12 hex characters of a SHA-256); photos, links and listing text are not published.

labels.held_out_rule: grouped by listing; the listings held out at label batch 2 stay held out, only new listings are split

agent_vs_agent.first_896: 108 photos labelled twice: 94-100% agreement on subject, setting, people and offer
agent_vs_agent.batch_1: 24 shared photos: 23-24 of 24 agreed per field
agent_vs_agent.batch_2: 24 shared photos: accessibility cues agreed on 19 of 24; disputed cues kept only where both labellers marked them

eg2.model: google/embeddinggemma-2 at revision f9972ac2, image only, 140 image tokens, about 0.1 s a photo on an RTX 3080 Ti
eg2.heads_held_out_380: see records.jsonl and heads_report.txt; subject answers bathroom 51/51, bedroom 24/24, indoor common area 60/65, scenery 68/72, activity 24/25 pass the gate; setting indoor 223/225, outdoor 245/257; bathtub 19/19 passes; bed 20/21 (lower bound 77%) does not
eg2.catalogue_read: 1,900 listings in 23 minutes, about 0.7 s a listing

qwen.model: Qwen/Qwen3.5-2B, thinking off, greedy, photos at 768 px
qwen.lora: r16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05, language-model projections only, vision frozen, 2 epochs, lr 1e-4, photos with a cue or a generic offer shown 3 times, Modal A10G
qwen.prompt: listing name, category and a 400-character description excerpt, the cue definitions, one line of JSON

mining.labels_after: grab bar 71, step-free shower 30, ramp 21, wheelchair 19 positives in all 1,532

joint_image_text_vector.what: hero photo plus name in the EG2 vision space as one ranking arm, weight chosen on a development split
joint_image_text_vector.caveat: the labelled queries are text-led; none asks what a place looks like

decision: Accessibility is never read from photos. Accessibility facts are stated by the operator, not photographed; a photo without a ramp says nothing about whether there is one; and a wrong step-free claim harms the person who relied on it. The fine-tuned Qwen was not served.
